an8.148-627:1.1: “Bhikkhus, for direct knowledge … for full understanding … for the utter destruction … for the abandoning … for the destruction … for the vanishing … for the fading away … for the cessation … for the giving up … for the relinquishment of hatred …
an8.148-627:1.26: these eight things are to be developed.”
an8.148-627:1.27: This is what the Blessed One said. Elated, those bhikkhus delighted in the Blessed One’s statement.
an8.148-627:1.28: The Book of the Eights is finished.
